clause_span: All production AI models must be tested for algorithmic bias and demographic disparity using evaluated fairness metrics.
root_cause: Top-K truncation / lexical tie-breaking. NIST-AI-RMF-MEASURE-MANAGE scored 0.36 via CTRL-FAIR-BIAS-DETECTION and tied with other AI governance controls, ranking 6th (just outside Top 5).
appropriate_remediation: Enhance candidate score fusion to reward specific measurement and evaluation keywords ('metrics evaluated', 'tested for bias') when scoring NIST-AI-RMF-MEASURE-MANAGE.

clause_span: Approval logs and prompt audit logs must be retained for at least 7 years for regulatory inspection.
root_cause: Missing control facet bridge and statutory cue for recordkeeping. The clause specifies 7-year retention of approval and prompt audit logs. Policy extraction captured 'prompt_logging' and 'approval_logs_retained', which map to CTRL-TECH-OBSERVABILITY and CTRL-FIN-APPROVAL-THRESHOLDS. Neither maps to AU-PRIV-APP1-GOV (CTRL-PRIV-GOVERNANCE), and the clause lacks statutory APP 1 cues.
appropriate_remediation: Add recordkeeping and audit log retention bridges linking governance documentation facets to APP 1.2 compliance recordkeeping duties, and register retention period cues in reconciliation ranking.

clause_span: AI agents must not execute payments above AUD 500 without prior human approval.
root_cause: Domain mapping discrepancy between operational risk and human oversight. Clause specifies pre-execution human approval threshold for AI payments. Retrieval correctly prioritized AU-NAIC-AI6-TEST-HUMAN (rank 1), but ground truth expected AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS. CPS 230 currently maps only to CTRL-OPS-RISK and lacks payment threshold facet wiring.
appropriate_remediation: Multi-obligation retrieval: add operational risk execution limit cues for financial transactions under CPS 230 paras 22-33, allowing both AU-NAIC-AI6-TEST-HUMAN and AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS to be retrieved jointly.

clause_span: Payments above AUD 500 may be executed before manager review during peak volume periods.
root_cause: Permissive post-execution exception maps to human oversight (AU-NAIC-AI6-TEST-HUMAN, rank 1), but lacks operational resilience link to CPS 230 operational risk tolerances. Ground truth expected AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS.
appropriate_remediation: Bridge permissive execution carve-outs during peak volume to CPS 230 operational risk tolerance controls (CTRL-OPS-RISK).

clause_span: All outbound transfers exceeding AUD 10,000 require senior executive sign-off prior to release.
root_cause: Senior executive transfer sign-off ($10,000 threshold) retrieved EU AI Act deployer oversight (rank 1) and RG 104 (rank 2) but missed AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS (rank None) due to absence of high-value transfer operational risk cue in CPS 230.
appropriate_remediation: Wire dual-authorisation and executive sign-off threshold facets to CPS 230 operational controls.

clause_span: Customer dispute escalations must be handled within 30 days unless an informal resolution is agreed.
root_cause: Clause segmentation/lexical pattern gap. Text mentions 'customer dispute escalations must be handled within 30 days'. In reconciliation.py, the statutory cue required 'internal dispute resolution', 'afca', 'dissatisfaction', or 'rg 271'. The token 'dispute' or 'dispute escalations' without 'internal' failed to trigger the RG 271 cue. Additionally, policy.py lacked a dispute escalation facet.
appropriate_remediation: Add 'dispute', 'dispute escalation', and 'complaint handling' patterns to policy.py and expand RG 271 statutory cues in reconciliation.py to match 'dispute' and '30 days'.

clause_span: Credit scoring AI algorithms must verify accuracy and explainability before automated denial decisions.
root_cause: Credit conduct obligation omitted due to narrow lexical cues. Clause text 'credit scoring AI algorithms must verify accuracy and explainability before automated denial' failed to match the narrow NCCP cue ('nccp', 's 128', 'not unsuitable', 'unsuitability', 'living expenses'). Neither 'credit scoring' nor 'automated denial' triggered AU-NCCP-S47-CONDUCT.
appropriate_remediation: Expand NCCP Act instrument cues to recognize credit scoring, automated credit denials, and credit licensee general conduct obligations under s 47.

clause_span: AI operational disruption tolerance limits are defined per Schedule B4 of the Business Continuity Plan.
root_cause: Competing obligation from same standard ranked higher. Clause references disruption tolerance limits per Schedule B4 of BCP. AU-APRA-CPS230-BCP scored 0.70 and ranked #1, while AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS scored 0.44 and ranked #7 (Top-K cutoff at 5).
appropriate_remediation: Incorporate CPS 230 multi-obligation clustering so disruption tolerance and BCP clauses co-retrieve both AU-APRA-CPS230-BCP and AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS.

clause_span: Critical business operations must maintain tested offline recovery procedures for all automated decision models.
root_cause: Lexical interference from automated decision token. Clause specifies 'critical business operations must maintain tested offline recovery procedures for all automated decision models'. Triggered APP 1.7 (rank 1) and CPS 230 BCP (rank 2). AU-APRA-CPS230-OPS was pushed out of Top 5.
appropriate_remediation: Balance automated decision keyword weighting against operational resilience keywords ('offline recovery', 'critical operations') to co-rank CPS 230 operational risk.

clause_span: The bank has not yet implemented real-time drift detection for consumer credit scoring.
root_cause: Narrow NCCP cues missed credit drift monitoring. Clause 'bank has not yet implemented real-time drift detection for consumer credit scoring' retrieved privacy and lending suitability controls, but missed AU-NCCP-S47-CONDUCT because 'consumer credit scoring' was not mapped to general conduct.
appropriate_remediation: Link credit scoring risk monitoring to AU-NCCP-S47-CONDUCT via credit model governance aliases.
